scope: Observed-population belief and narrative forecasting; incremental price-aware research; advisory-only Tensor context.
universe: Must be agreed and frozen before experiment; no implied live ticker recommendation.
global_clock_policy: Use available_at=max(required source receipts, completed feature computation). Include only closed market bars; prospective information ledger. Windows and sessions follow verified exchange calendar.
threshold_status: Candidate preregistration defaults, not fitted results or recommended live thresholds. Freeze or revise on development data before untouched evaluation; log every variant.

feature_definitions.S_g_w: Weighted mean(p_bull-p_bear) for target-entity attributable claims first available in nonoverlapping window w, by observed population g; one capped weight per author and one independent-information weight per origin; neutral/mixed masses retained. Empty window -> null.
feature_definitions.U_g_w: Weighted proportion of attributable claims labeled uncertain/conditional plus explicit elicited distribution width where comparable, stored as separate fields; never average unlike units. Text uncertainty fraction is the default for cards below.
feature_definitions.D_between: Jensen-Shannon divergence of bullish/bearish/neutral/mixed distributions across named observed populations, using fixed equal-population weights and fixed taxonomy; require >=2 covered populations.
feature_definitions.D_within: Weighted variance of author-level expected stance p_bull-p_bear within each named population, reporting each population separately.
feature_definitions.A_w: log(1+unique information-origin count in w), seasonally standardized by comparable time-of-day/day-of-week windows fit in training. Author count and share of universe discussion are companion checks, not silently substituted.
feature_definitions.A_velocity: A_t-A_(t-w) for adjacent nonoverlapping comparable windows.
feature_definitions.A_acceleration: A_t-2*A_(t-w)+A_(t-2w) for adjacent nonoverlapping comparable windows.
feature_definitions.novelty: 1-max cosine similarity to earlier available same-entity claim embeddings in trailing 20 completed sessions; pinned embedding version. factual_new requires a newly evidenced proposition, not semantic novelty alone.
feature_definitions.echo_share: Number of sampled items whose entire supported proposition set is contained in an earlier available information-origin cluster divided by all sampled items; exposure duplicates retained here, never treated as corroboration.
feature_definitions.adoption_rate: Unique new authors expressing the fixed claim during w divided by all eligible active covered authors during w; define author and sampling frame point-in-time; missing denominator -> null.
feature_definitions.diffusion_breadth: Number of named observed populations with >=2 independently authored attributable mentions of a fixed claim divided by number of covered named populations; lineage-copied texts do not qualify as independent factual corroboration.
feature_definitions.H_narrative: -sum(q_k*log(q_k))/log(K), K fixed predeclared narrative classes, q weighted by unique authors; K<2 or no valid text -> null; new-theme bucket retained.
feature_definitions.concentration: sum(q_k^2) over same fixed narrative shares used by H_narrative.
feature_definitions.price_response: Residual cumulative log return from the first executable observation after available_at through t, controlling in training for market/sector returns, realized volatility, spread, event class and surprise magnitude. Requires all return bars complete as of t.
feature_definitions.expected_surprise: Pre-event model distribution of comparable actual-minus-consensus, based only on timestamped consensus and evidence available before release. Standardize by trailing event-specific forecast-error SD fit in training; zero/unknown SD -> null.
feature_definitions.realized_surprise: First-release comparable actual-minus-pre-event-consensus divided by trailing event-specific forecast-error SD fit in training; available only after official receipt; retain revisions separately.
feature_definitions.novel_claim_count: Number of unique origin-supported propositions passing factual_new and human-calibrated entailment policy in w.
feature_definitions.same_author_revision: Mean current-minus-prior expected stance among a stable matched panel of authors observed in both windows, with fixed author cap; entrants and leavers reported separately.
feature_definitions.borrow_constraint: Vector of point-in-time published short-interest/float, report age, days-to-cover, verified borrow fee and availability; no collapse to signed score. Missing borrow components remain missing.
feature_definitions.return_tail: Forward residual return crossing +/-2 times ex-ante horizon volatility forecast, where volatility model is fitted using past information only.
feature_definitions.price_aware_Z: Current and lagged completed-bar returns, market/sector exposure, realized volatility, volume, spread/liquidity if observed, calendar and known events, event severity/surprise if already released, source coverage and latency. Unknown variables do not default to zero.
feature_definitions.q_p: Within-entity/source/time-of-day empirical p-quantile estimated from the training window only; thresholds frozen for evaluation. Cross-sectional fallback only if preregistered and history sparse; otherwise abstain.

common_baselines: Frozen Tensor policy on identical eligible opportunities

inference.dependence_unit: Event/origin family and date blocks, with correlated assets clustered
inference.labels: Independently sampled and human-audited future expressed beliefs; forward executable residual returns separately
inference.splits: Chronological nested walk-forward; purge overlapping features/labels/events; embargo based on actual dependency horizon
inference.multiple_testing: Record all feature/threshold/source/label/model variants, adjust inferential family prospectively

patterns.name: Verified-new information versus stale echo
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Information/inference: costly interpretation and independent dissemination may differ from repetition of already priced information.
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: At first completed 15-minute decision window after receipt, novel_claim_count>=1 and novelty>q_0.8; compare with echo_share>q_0.8 at matched stance strength and attention. Require provenance-backed actual new fact.
patterns.comparator: Price-aware_Z + event facts + A + S baseline; matched new versus echo windows by issuer, event class, prior move, liquidity, time since receipt, and source coverage.
target: Signed next-window population stance change in direction of the new claim
Incremental signed residual return after information becomes actionable
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: New verified claims produce more durable belief adoption than stale echoes; any extra return response must survive price/event controls.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Fast information may already be priced before model extraction. Stale labels can be wrong when an update changes a number. Capture window may be shorter than Tensor eligibility; do not chase.
patterns.strongest_rival: Semantic novelty proxies event severity or delayed vendor ingestion, not interpretive advantage.
patterns.falsifier: Reject mechanism if no greater prospective adoption for new claims under matched facts, or effect survives only with incorrectly early timestamps. Reject deployability if incremental net paired utility upper bound is below preregistered minimum.
patterns.negative_control: Duplicate a stored article under new URLs: factual evidence and prediction should not strengthen; exposure count may change only in explicit synthetic invariance test.
patterns.promotion_rule: Preregister minimum economically meaningful effect and uncertainty/error budget before untouched evaluation. Require incremental calibrated forecast value and, for any later trading claim, paired net utility on identical Tensor opportunities. Wide intervals -> INCONCLUSIVE; upper bound below minimum -> NOT_DEPLOYABLE. No automatic live policy change.

Next-session stance persistence
Secondary: absolute residual return / activity, not predetermined return sign

patterns.falsifier: Reject if forecast improvement disappears after source receipt/batching controls or under stable-source sampling, or same effect occurs in outage recovery windows.

patterns.name: Optimistic consensus exhaustion

patterns.comparator: Price momentum/reversal + attention levels + same optimism without adoption slowdown; match known news, volatility and liquidity.
target: Probability next-5-session S decreases by more than training-defined 0.5 SD
Secondary: next-5-session residual return and downside-tail probability
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Belief continuation weakens after diffusion saturation; profitable contrarian trading is a separate stronger claim.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: A saturated narrative may remain correct for months; crowding is not a timing signal. Short borrow/recall and squeeze risk can dominate.
patterns.strongest_rival: Ordinary price mean reversion or low news arrival rather than narrative exhaustion.
patterns.falsifier: Reject mechanism if matched consensus with and without slowdown has indistinguishable prospective stance persistence at adequate precision; reject return claim if price-only explains it.
patterns.negative_control: High consensus supported by continuing verified upward fundamental revisions.

patterns.comparator: Price-aware volatility/event baseline; compare high disagreement-low uncertainty with low disagreement-high uncertainty at equal aggregate stance and event magnitude.
target: Post-event decline in D_between and absolute same_author_revision
Absolute residual return and tail frequency; no fixed sign

patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Event gaps and volatility premia may make option purchases lose despite correct volatility forecasts; inference must not assume risk-neutral probabilities are physical.
patterns.strongest_rival: Population sampling changes or pre-event volatility already capture everything.
patterns.falsifier: Reject if predeclared interaction D_between*low_U does not outperform separate levels in prospective belief changes, or effect vanishes with stable panels.

target: Future social claim share and stance revision
Secondary incremental residual returns conditional on initial price response
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Observed early-source adoption predicts later adoption in another population when latency differences are genuine.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Editorial labels do not prove an institutional investor audience. Provider polling latency can manufacture lead-lag.
patterns.strongest_rival: A common unobserved release reaches both groups simultaneously; measured migration is vendor delay.
patterns.falsifier: Reject if direction/order disappears after original publication and receipt-latency controls, or does not improve adoption forecasts over source-specific persistence.

patterns.name: Horizon dissonance
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Distinct holding horizons: near-term caution and long-term conviction may resolve differently than uniform pessimism.
exact_measurable_features: S_g_w separately for explicit <=5-session and >=20-session expressed horizons
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: Explicit short-horizon S<q_0.2 and long-horizon S>q_0.8 in same observed population; require explicit horizons, never infer horizon from tone.
patterns.comparator: Price-aware_Z + aggregate stance and source composition; match uniformly bearish and uniformly bullish episodes on event type.
target: Short-horizon stance revision toward long-horizon stance
Secondary 5- versus 20-session residual returns
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Temporary concerns fade more often when longer-horizon expectations remain positive and unchanged.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Long-horizon bullish language may be promotional boilerplate. A 20-day forecast cannot justify an intraday entry.
patterns.strongest_rival: Different author samples rather than genuine within-author horizon distinction.
patterns.falsifier: Reject if effect fails within same-author dual-horizon claims or explicit horizons cannot be extracted reliably.

patterns.name: Negative-news absorption with diminishing response
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Expectation incorporation: comparable bad news may increasingly be anticipated, reducing further belief deterioration.
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: At least three separate verified same-class negative-surprise events over <=20 sessions; training-model residual absolute negative price response declines across events while surprise severity does not decline; all measured after completed response windows.
patterns.comparator: Event/price-aware model with surprise size, beta, liquidity, volatility, elapsed time and prior cumulative drawdown; matched cases without diminishing response.
target: Less-negative next-session stance change
Secondary positive next-5-session residual returns
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Repeated bad news that moves price less may signal expectations are already depressed; not automatic bullishness.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Quiet price can reflect halted trading, illiquidity or market-wide offset. Initial response must not include future bar information.
patterns.strongest_rival: Changing news severity, hedging flows, or broad market rally masks adverse fundamentals.
patterns.falsifier: Reject if effect vanishes after event severity/market controls or appears equally around stale non-new stories; failure to recover is not rescued by relabeling the regime.
patterns.negative_control: Repeated negative adjectives without fresh facts, and halted/stale-price periods excluded beforehand.

patterns.name: Upbeat tone but disappointment versus expectations
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Semantic inference: positive absolute news can be negative relative to already priced expectations.
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: At official release receipt, positive headline tone but standardized realized_surprise<q_0.2 for a prespecified economically relevant variable; actual/consensus units, period and definition match.
patterns.comparator: Price-aware_Z + numerical realized surprise; compare lexicon/FinBERT tone-only versus structured expectation-relative extraction with equal parameter budget.
target: Next-session negative population stance revision
Incremental next-session residual return beyond numeric surprise baseline
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Expectation-relative extraction should avoid wrongly bullish interpretations; extra return alpha may be zero once the surprise is known.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Consensus may be stale or not comparable; guidance and segment mix can dominate a single headline metric. Need receipt lag and no pre-release leakage.
patterns.strongest_rival: All useful information resides in the numeric surprise and price; LLM explanation adds nothing.
patterns.falsifier: Reject LLM increment if it fails against numeric-surprise baseline, even if it beats tone-only; reject extraction if matched accounting definitions are unreliable.
patterns.negative_control: Positive growth that genuinely beats comparable expectations, and shuffled consensus within same metric/period.

patterns.name: Constrained shorts plus new positive evidence
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Constraint/access mechanism: documented bearish exposure and limited financing flexibility can amplify new information, but reported shorts need not be forced buyers.
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: Latest legally available short-interest/float and days-to-cover both >q_0.8; verified recent borrow fee high/availability constrained; factual_new positive event and positive stable-panel stance revision. Missing borrow evidence -> unavailable, not squeeze label.
patterns.comparator: Price/volatility/liquidity + short-interest levels + event surprise baseline; interaction with new evidence and stance must add value.
target: Probability of next-1/5-session positive residual tail
Post-event stance/adoption change
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Positive evidence combined with constrained shorts may create asymmetric upside-tail risk; use as risk context, not a guaranteed squeeze or entry.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Short-interest publication lag; hedged short positions; borrow recalls; halts; gaps; extreme spreads. Raw options OI cannot identify dealer gamma sign.
patterns.strongest_rival: High short interest correctly reflects distress and the positive news is temporary or already priced.
patterns.falsifier: Reject if interaction does not improve tail forecasts over price/borrow/event baseline, or only succeeds using settlement-date information before publication.
patterns.negative_control: Daily short-sale-volume substituted for short interest must be rejected by schema; high short interest with no new evidence.

patterns.comparator: Price reversal + volatility + post-burst elapsed time baseline; compare matched bursts with continued new adoption.
target: Next-5-session lower stance persistence
Next-5-session downside-tail probability

patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Crowded fades can squeeze again; borrow unavailable or expensive; a correct eventual reversal may lose on path/margin.

patterns.falsifier: Reject if no incremental benefit over post-jump price baseline or delay/cost stress eliminates paired utility.

Next-session realized volatility conditional on current volatility; no return sign

patterns.falsifier: Reject incremental claim if U adds nothing after event timing/implied-volatility baseline; reject uncertainty measure if rhetorical certainty does not track independently elicited widths where available.

patterns.name: Credibility-weighted contradiction

patterns.mechanism: Information correction: verified correction of a high-reach claim can update sampled beliefs, with magnitude depending on prior exposure and credibility.

Secondary residual return after actionable correction

patterns.name: Entrant-driven consensus versus genuine revisions
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Selection/composition: an apparent sentiment swing created by incoming speakers may be less persistent than a change in existing speakers' beliefs.
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: Aggregate |delta S|>q_0.9; decompose into within-stable-panel, entrants and leavers using fixed weights. Compare top versus bottom q_0.8 entrant contribution fractions, conditional on equal aggregate shift.
patterns.comparator: Aggregate stance autoregression + source coverage + price_aware_Z; stable-panel decomposition is the sole added concept.
target: Next-5-session reversal probability of aggregate stance
Same-author stance persistence
patterns.hypothesized_consequence: Composition-driven shifts are hypothesized less persistent; a valid contrary result would mean new entrants contain durable information.
patterns.permitted_current_use: Advisory annotation / shadow forecast only. Tensor alone decides entry timing, closed-bar validity, and no-chase eligibility.
patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Missing posts/deleted accounts and API changes distort panel membership. New participants can be genuine informed adoption, not noise.
patterns.strongest_rival: Entrants are the mechanism of true diffusion and more persistent, not less.
patterns.falsifier: Reject proposed direction if entrant-driven shifts are equally or more persistent at adequate precision; do not discard entrants merely because hypothesis fails.
patterns.negative_control: Known API coverage expansion, which must yield coverage alert rather than belief-change signal.

patterns.name: Prior expected-surprise asymmetry
patterns.novelty_claim: Original engineering synthesis; no claim of literature novelty or established alpha.
patterns.mechanism: Expectations matter twice: beliefs about a likely surprise affect the update generated by the actual release.
patterns.prespecified_candidate_trigger: Before event, archive P(actual-consensus>delta); after release compare events with equal realized surprise but different preregistered pre-event expected-surprise quantiles and uncertainty. No post-release text in prior.
patterns.comparator: Realized surprise + price_aware_Z + event type + consensus dispersion; augmented model adds archived pre-event expected-surprise distribution.
target: Post-release same-author stance change
Residual price response after receipt

patterns.timing_and_execution_risks: Public consensus may differ from whisper expectations; multiple release dimensions; gaps mean a correct response forecast may be untradeable.

patterns.falsifier: Reject text increment if archived expectation distribution fails versus consensus-and-price baseline; any benefit requiring hindsight reconstruction invalidates the test.

patterns.promotion_rule: Preregister minimum economically meaningful effect and uncertainty/error budget before untouched evaluation.
